record.field: Skill package registry: publish/search/share/download skill zips. Writes via skill_publish/skill_download/skill_share/skill_unshare/skill_archive; reads via odoo_record_retriever on skillhub.skill.

SkillHub: registry of skill packages (zip files stored as ir.attachment). Models: skillhub.skill (one skill), skillhub.category (dynamic categories; a skill has one category_id).
Read / search — use the generic odoo_record_retriever; record rules (owner/shared/public) already limit what you can read: - List or search: odoo_record_retriever(model="skillhub.skill", domain=[["state","=","active"],["title","ilike","QUERY"]], fields=["id","code","title","description","version","category_id","depends_on_ids"]) - Search across code OR title OR description: domain=["&","|","|",["code","ilike",Q],["title","ilike",Q],["description","ilike",Q],["state","=","active"]] - Always filter state="active" for normal search; archived skills stay readable by their owner but are not part of search. - Fields: category_id is a many2one (returns [id, name]); depends_on_ids / required_by_ids are many2many (id lists); is_public boolean; shared_user_ids many2many; size/sha256 technical.
Publish (consumes an uploaded attachment): 1. attachment_stage_upload(filename) returns an attachment_id. 2. curl the returned URL to upload the zip bytes. 3. attachment_commit_upload(attachment_id) verifies the upload. 4. skill_publish(attachment_id, code, title, description, version, category_id, depends_on_ids) returns {skill_id, attachment_id}.
The attachment must be readable by you and not yet bound to any record; publishing binds it to the skill, so it can be used once. Invariants: code is a slug (letters/digits/./_/-, starts with a letter or digit) and unique; publishing an existing code replaces that skill's package and metadata (single version); only the owner of an existing code may overwrite it. Omit category_id or depends_on_ids to keep existing values.
Download: skill_download(skill_id) returns {download, curl}; fetch the URL with curl (bytes do not go through MCP). Access follows the skill's read rules: owner, shared users, or is_public.
Share / archive (owner-only): skill_share(skill_id, user_ids), skill_unshare(skill_id, user_ids), skill_archive(skill_id). Archive (state=archived) is the lifecycle exit; there is no delete.
